caption: The drawing depicts a hand mirror with a decorative handle and an ornate, shield-shaped frame around the reflective surface. The main feature of the mirror’s back is a raised, oval medallion displaying the profile of a man with a bald head and dressed in a formal coat, facing to the right. The handle is elongated and curved, with subtle carved linear details, and two rounded ends. The shield-shaped frame around the medallion has beveled edges for added texture. The drawing includes three perspectives: a large three-quarter view showing the relief and depth of the embossed portrait and mirror, a top-down orthographic view of the mirror, and a side profile showing the thinness of the object and its slightly raised rim. All elements are rendered in grayscale pencil on a neutral background, with clear shading to define contours and depth. There is also a scale beneath the side profile indicating dimensions in inches, aligned with the technical illustration style of the composition.
title: Flatiron Holder
